linkedin.title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news, not informed.
linkedin.body:
It is easy to blame the algorithm for this. We scroll through endless feeds, trying to separate signal from noise, but we often end up exhausted instead of smarter. The problem is not just the volume of information. The problem is that most news feeds treat everyone exactly the same.

True intelligence is not about reading everything. It is about reading the right things for your specific life, career, and curiosity. When you filter out the noise that does not matter to you, you actually have the time to understand the stories that do.

This is where AI changes the game. It should not be used to create echo chambers or push outrage. It should be a tool that respects your time by curating a briefing that is actually relevant to you. Personalization is simply the difference between drowning in data and having a clear view of the world.

I am curious how you keep up. Do you feel like you are getting the full picture, or are you just catching headlines as they fly by?

instagram.title: SpaceX Buys AI Coding Firm

slides.headline: SpaceX Buys AI Coding Firm
slides.subtitle: Plus big updates from D23 and the future of fusion energy.

slides.headline: Ahsoka Returns With Darker Twists
slides.explanation: Lucasfilm just dropped the first trailer for the second season of Ahsoka at D23. The new season promises a darker, witchcraft-focused tone when it premieres in January 2027.

slides.headline: Marvel And Star Wars Updates
slides.explanation: Disney used D23 to reveal new looks at the X-Men movie, Avengers: Doomsday, and the VisionQuest series. These projects signal a major push to refresh the Marvel and Star Wars lineups for fans.

slides.headline: SpaceX Acquires AI Coding Startup
slides.explanation: SpaceX has finalized its purchase of the AI coding platform Cursor. This $60 billion deal marks a major expansion for the company into software development tools.

slides.headline: Cursor Is Now Part Of SpaceX
slides.explanation: The AI coding startup Cursor is now officially operating under the SpaceX umbrella. This move highlights how deeply AI is becoming integrated into aerospace engineering workflows.

slides.headline: Fusion Energy Funding Hits $7 Billion
slides.explanation: Fusion startups have raised over $7 billion, though most of that money is concentrated in just a few companies. It shows that investors are betting big on the potential for clean, limitless power.

story_card.headline: Blue and fin whales are returning to the Atlantic
story_card.standfirst: The world's two largest animals are slowly rebounding after decades of commercial whaling.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Sightings of blue and fin whales are increasing in the southeast Atlantic Ocean.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Researchers analyzed 60 years of data following the ban on commercial whaling.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This shows marine populations can slowly recover decades after human threats stop.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Future studies will track if these whale populations continue to grow.

story_card.caption:
Blue and fin whale populations are showing signs of recovery in the southeast Atlantic.

New research published in the African Journal of Marine Science confirms that sightings of these massive whales are up. It is a hopeful sign more than 40 years after commercial whaling was outlawed.

Does it surprise you how long it takes for whale populations to bounce back?
